newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V MINOR COUNTIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V MINOR COUNTIES.

text.p: Australia won the toss and decided to bat in their one-day match against Minor Counties on Tuesday.
Minor Counties - S.Dean, G.Ecclestone, M.Fell, S.Myles, I.Cockbain (captain), R.Dalton, M.Humphries, J.Fielding, A.Richardson, M.Sharp, S.Oakes.
Australia - M.Slater, J.Langer, R.Ponting, B.Julian, M.Bevan, G.Blewett, D.Berry, M.Elliott, S.Waugh (captain), M.Kasprowicz, P.Reiffel.
Weather sunny and warm with a firm wicket.
